title: How much do you know about Uruguayan lamb from the Boutique of meats of the world?
subtitle: Answer correctly and win a prize

fields.label: Which sector do you belong to?

questions.prompt: What types of meat does Uruguay export to Brazil?
questions.feedback: Uruguay is recognized for producing and exporting beef and lamb, with high quality standards and a strong presence in international markets.

options.label: A promotional brand for Uruguayan lamb

questions.feedback: Uruguay Lamb is the country brand that represents and promotes Uruguayan lamb in international markets. It is not a private brand, but a sector initiative led by the National Meat Institute.

questions.prompt: According to the Uruguay Lamb campaign, Uruguayan lamb is part of:

options.label: The Boutique of meats of the world

questions.feedback: The 'Uruguayan Lamb from the Boutique de Carnes do Mundo' campaign promotes the quality and origin of Uruguayan lamb as a premium product for the Brazilian market.

questions.prompt: What characterizes the Uruguayan lamb production system?
questions.feedback: Uruguayan lamb is mostly raised on natural pastures, which contributes to quality, flavor and a more sustainable production.

questions.prompt: Why is lamb more tender than sheep meat?
questions.feedback: Lamb is more tender because it comes from young animals (between 4 and 12 months), resulting in softer, more tender meat.
Lamb is a versatile meat: it can be prepared on the grill, in the oven or in quick cuts, adapting to different occasions.
